title: Release checks
lead: See which checks and reviews are confirmed for this running version, then open what still needs evidence.
unconfirmed: The current result is not confirmed
boundary: These recorded checks do not replace the required human and release approvals.
noCurrentReport: There is no confirmed, current set of reports for this running version. This does not prove that a connected service has stopped.
savedRead: Saved results read. Nothing was sent again.
checkOnly: This reads the latest saved reports. It does not repeat a delivery, restart a service or release a version.
missingReportHelp: No report has been confirmed for this running version yet. Ask the person responsible for release to provide the matching report before treating this check as complete.
noDependentChecks: No further dependent check is listed in the current rules.

results.not_confirmed: No qualifying report is confirmed for this version.
results.rejected: A report was received but did not meet the required checks.

R00.title: Responsibilities and release rules
R00.help: The release scope, responsible people and required proof must be agreed.

R01.title: System checks and access
R01.help: Check the running application, database changes, staff and client access.

R02.title: Listing facts and publication
R02.help: People must review the source facts, availability, photos and publication decision.

R03.title: Search and inquiries
R03.help: Check approved search results and that an inquiry reaches its responsible person.

R04.title: Client work and next steps
R04.help: Check requirements, viewings, proposals, documents and continuity of the deal.

R05.title: Messages and privacy
R05.help: Check real delivery, access changes, consent and requests about personal information.

R06.title: Butler and manual fallback
R06.help: Check Butler with the connected model and keep the manual workflow available.

R07.title: Source pages and photos
R07.help: Check every old address, source record and photo, including the final transfer.

R08.title: Reliability and recovery
R08.help: Check load, security, alerts, protected backups and return to the previous version.

R09.title: Journeys, language and accessibility
R09.help: Review the complete journeys, approved content, languages and accessible controls.

R10.title: Release evidence and approval
R10.help: The exact version needs current proof and the required release approvals.

R11.title: Checks after public routing changes
R11.help: Check actual domains, secure connections, inquiries, access, photos and old addresses.

R12.title: Agency operating review
R12.help: A complete operating cycle and the responsible owner must confirm the handover.

businessReports.title: Business reports
businessReports.about: Find work that needs attention and review recorded service outcomes.
businessReports.snapshot: Open work is a current snapshot. The selected period applies to response, viewing and stage-change observations. This is a rolling, incomplete period.
businessReports.empty: No matching records within your access.
businessReports.denied: Your access does not include this measure.
businessReports.sample: Only the first 20 matching records are shown. The total includes all matching records within your access.
businessReports.unavailable: The report could not be read. The totals are unknown. Your work has not changed.
businessReports.responseDefinition: Requests received in the selected period. A recorded useful human contact counts; an automatic acknowledgement does not. Duration is elapsed time from receipt to that contact, including time outside staffed hours.
businessReports.missing: Without a valid recorded useful response
businessReports.median: Median elapsed minutes among recorded responses
businessReports.small: Fewer than five recorded responses: a small sample.
businessReports.incomplete: Missing responses are not treated as zero-minute responses. This cohort can change as more responses are recorded.
businessReports.staffed: Response time within staffed hours is unknown until approved hours and their policy are connected to these observations.
businessReports.effort: Correction and re-entry effort is unknown: this report has no recorded effort observations.
businessReports.invalid: Some response times fall outside their valid receipt-to-observation interval and are excluded from duration calculations.
businessReports.scopeNotice: Totals and links cover only records and fields your current access permits. Opening a record checks access again. Use Back to return to these filters.

unowned.title: Requests awaiting a named owner
unowned.definition: Open received, assigned or waiting requests without a named owner. Their coverage queue retains responsibility. Unowned requests are outside My responsibility.

promises.title: Overdue client promises
promises.definition: Open, in-progress or waiting tasks with a recorded client promise and an elapsed promised due time. Internal follow-up alone is not a client promise.

nextActions.title: Deals with a due next step or review
nextActions.definition: Active deals with an elapsed next-action or waiting-review time. This measure requires access to internal deal work.

viewings.title: Recorded completed viewings
viewings.definition: Appointments currently recorded as completed whose confirmed end falls in the selected period. A request, confirmation or past appointment alone is not completion.

progressions.title: Recorded stage changes
progressions.definition: Recorded changes from one deal stage to a different stage during the selected period. Initial creation is excluded. This counts events, including reversals, rather than distinct deals or inferred conversion.

freshness.title: Listings needing freshness review
freshness.definition: Listings with an elapsed review time, review due, conflicting or unknown freshness. A timer never confirms availability.

deliveries.title: Email deliveries needing attention
deliveries.definition: Outgoing deal emails currently failed, bounced or with an unknown outcome. Provider acceptance does not prove delivery; no recipient or message content appears here.

taskEffort.title: Correction and reentry time
taskEffort.about: Record the minutes you spent on this task. These are reported observations, not automatic time tracking.
taskEffort.empty: No time has been recorded. This does not mean the work took no time.
taskEffort.hint: Enter a whole number from 1 to 480 minutes. Do not include customer details.
taskEffort.failed: The entry was not recorded. Check the current task before trying again.
taskEffort.pending: This entry is still being checked. Refresh its status before trying again.
taskEffort.unknown: The result is not known. Check the same entry before recording it again.
taskEffort.reportNote: Self-reported time recorded during this period, after excluding mistaken entries. No observations means unknown effort.
